name: linkget
title: Linkget
description: Save post photos, videos, audio, and offline articles via Linkget.
author: popcornnnnnnnn

commands.name: save-link
commands.title: Save Link
commands.subtitle: Linkget
commands.description: Inspect and save photos, videos, audio, offline articles, or transcripts from any supported link

commands.name: quick-save-article
commands.title: Quick Save Article
commands.subtitle: Linkget
commands.description: One-shot offline archive of an article URL (argument, clipboard, or active browser tab)

arguments.name: url
arguments.placeholder: Article URL (optional — uses clipboard or active browser tab)

commands.name: browse-tasks
commands.title: Browse Downloads & Articles
commands.subtitle: Linkget
commands.description: Browse saved articles, media downloads, and background read tasks

commands.name: status-and-tools
commands.title: Linkget Status & Maintenance
commands.subtitle: Linkget
commands.description: Inspect linkget installation, engines, sessions, defaults, and temporary stage cleanup

preferences.name: linkgetPath
preferences.title: Linkget Binary Path
preferences.description: Path to the installed linkget CLI binary (default: /opt/homebrew/bin/linkget).

preferences.name: defaultArticleFolder
preferences.title: Default Article Archive Folder
preferences.description: Default folder for offline article archives when linkget config --article-folder is not set (falls back to ~/Downloads/Linkget Articles).

preferences.name: defaultMediaFolder
preferences.title: Default Media & Audio Folder
preferences.description: Optional folder override for media and audio downloads (blank follows linkget config; audio falls back to ~/Downloads).

preferences.name: defaultBrowser
preferences.title: Default Browser Session
preferences.description: Browser session source passed to linkget.

preferences.name: autoDetectClipboard
preferences.title: Auto-Detect Clipboard URL
preferences.description: Automatically pre-fill the URL field from the clipboard when opening Save Link.
preferences.label: Pre-fill URL from clipboard when opening Save Link
